headline: Chinese robots advance, investors line up
summary: Hundreds of Chinese robot manufacturers unveiled their latest robots in Beijing to convince investors and consumers that the robot revolution is breaking through. The event targets investor interest in the sector.
why: Humanoid and industrial robotics is a fast-growing investment theme, and China is a major hub for robot manufacturing and state-backed funding.
